title: Arena: make money and scale
briefing: You run a new transport company with a 1825-day mandate. Build whatever network you like (road, rail, air, water). When the mandate ends, your company keeps running **without you** for 365 more days; the reward is your **net worth (cash minus loan) after that run-off**, on a log scale: doing nothing scores 0, a simple scripted truck route scores about 0.18 (net worth £-1,521), and 1 needs 50 times that route's gain. Asset stripping and loan games do not help: only sustainable profit survives the run-off.
